plan.summary: BRO-5868: add a commercial entry for The Little Prince (2022) with its SEC Form D offering amount, labeled an estimate. All Out, Pass Over, Carousel, Beetlejuice and Dorian Gray leads have no citable source and are left out.

entry.capitalizationSource: Estimate from an SEC Form D filed Feb 7, 2022 by Little Prince Broadway Limited Partnership (New York, signed Jan 20, 2022): total offering amount $5,250,000. A Form D states the offering target, not final capitalization. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1905475/000189709222000001/primary_doc.xml
entry.notes: Limited run at the Broadway Theatre (previews Mar 29, 2022; opened Apr 11; closed May 8, 2022). No recoupment or final capitalization reported; the $5.25M is the Form D offering target and is an estimate.

actions.description: the-little-prince-2022: capitalization is the Form D offering target, an estimate
